items.title: Super Micro Computer Fourth-Quarter Profit Surges as Gross Margin Improves
items.summary: The server company reported a quarterly profit of $1.17 billion, up from $195.2 million in the year-ago period.

items.title: Quantinuum Posts First Earnings Since IPO; Strikes Oracle Quantum Deal
items.summary: Quantinuum reports higher-than-expected revenue and issues an upbeat annual outlook, though the stock barely budges.

items.title: Cava Stock Jumps on Foot Traffic Gains
items.summary: Cava  Group stock jumped more than 10% in Tuesday’s after hours trading after the restaurant chain delivered stronger-than-expected second quarter results as customer foot traffic continued to rise.  For the quarter ended July 12, Cava’s restaurant revenue increased 31.3% to $365.4 million, leaving total company revenue at $368.4 million.  Wall Street analysts polled by FactSet had expected roughly $360 million in revenue.

items.title: H&R Block Revenue Increases as It Raises Quarterly Dividend
items.summary: The company’s revenue increased to $1.14 billion from $1.11 billion, and it raised its quarterly dividend by 10% to 46 cents a share.

items.title: Smithfield Lowers Outlook on Consumer Caution, Softer Meat and Hog Markets
items.summary: Smithfield Foods cut its outlook for the year, as inflation-weary consumers continue to be choosier in the grocery store and higher costs pressure operations.

items.title: On Holding Tempers Outlook as Running-Shoe Sales Underwhelm
items.summary: The Swiss running-shoe maker now expects sales to grow in the low-20% range for the year after it deliberately stymied growth across its wholesale channels during the latest quarter.

items.title: Rapid7 Q2 Adjusted Income, Revenue Fall; Guides Q3
items.summary: Rapid7 (RPD) reported Q2 non-GAAP net income late Monday of $0.44 per diluted share, down from $0.58

items.title: Rocket Lab Narrows Loss As Revenue Climbs
items.summary: The launch and space systems company narrowed its loss and reported rising revenue as it ended its second quarter with a backlog of $2.36 billion, up 137% year-over-year.
